specification: Eduqas C700QS, current local specification v3 January 2019; preparation for 2027
coverage: Spoken Language AO7: formal presentation, purpose, vocabulary, organisation and audience
AO8: listening, responding to questions and feedback, developing further ideas
AO9: effective spoken Standard English, audibility and intelligibility
Separate competency-based endorsement with all criteria at a level required
assessment: Spoken Language is assessed holistically with Pass, Merit or Distinction (or Not Classified), not numerical marks and not as part of the written GCSE grade. Every numbered mark group here is solely a tutor-created practice allocation for a skill exercise, including the complete speech; none is an official exam tariff or endorsed grade. Notes and criteria are checked against the local specification and [official Spoken Language guidance](https://www.eduqas.co.uk/media/kn5hcgfv/guidance-on-the-assessment-of-spoken-language.pdf). The whole assessment guidance includes questions and feedback. The speech is an original illustrative proposal, not a factual account of school arrangements.
